policy: Only visual compositions at web-served image preview sizes inspected. Do not claim full-native-resolution sharpness or byte-level provenance verification.
No automatic rejection of earlier 20 KEEP decisions: explicit historical user approval applies to user-viewed selection, not B13 candidate file substitutions.
Contexts can be retained separately from exact object heroes; never use a site photo as relic close-up.
Both file-photo licence and underlying sculpture/mosaic rights are independent publication gates.
No paid rights, no contact, no publishing.
